columns: Multi religion household: Multi-person household: No people stated their religion
Multi religion household: Multi-person household: Same religion (at least one person has stated a religion but the household may include people who did not state their religion)
Multi religion household: Multi-person household: No religion (household may include people who did not state their religion)
Multi religion household: Multi-person household: Same religion and no religion (household may include people who did not state their religion)
Multi religion household: Multi-person household: At least two different religions stated (household may include people with no religion and who did not state their religion)
